# AWS Attribute Limit Processor

<!-- status autogenerated section -->
| Status        |           |
| ------------- |-----------|
| Stability     | [beta]: metrics   |
<!-- end autogenerated section -->

The AWS Attribute Limit processor enforces the aws backend 150-attribute limit per metric using a two-phase approach.

## How It Works

### Phase 1: Unconditional Removal

Always removes known-redundant resource attributes regardless of the total count. This includes:
- Node Feature Discovery (NFD) labels (`k8s.node.label.feature.node.kubernetes.io/`)
- Beta/legacy Kubernetes labels (`k8s.node.label.beta.kubernetes.io/`)
- eksctl labels (`k8s.node.label.alpha.eksctl.io/`)
- Redundant exact keys (e.g., `k8s.pod.label.pod-template-hash`, `k8s.node.label.topology.kubernetes.io/region`)

### Phase 2: Priority-Based Tier Dropping

If the total attribute count (resource + scope + datapoint) still exceeds the limit after Phase 1, attributes are dropped by tier priority (lowest tier dropped first):

| Tier | Category | Example |
|------|----------|---------|
| 1 | Helm/tooling labels | `helm.sh/chart`, `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by` |
| 2 | K8s internal controller labels | `pod-template-generation` |
| 3 | EKS system labels (node only) | `eks.amazonaws.com/capacityType` |
| 4 | Known-prefix node labels | `kubernetes.io/`, `karpenter.sh/` |
| 5 | Customer node labels | Unknown-prefix node labels |
| 6 | Known-prefix pod labels | `batch.kubernetes.io/` |
| 7 | Customer pod labels | Unknown-prefix pod labels |
| 8 | Non-protected datapoint attributes | `job`, `instance` |

Within the same tier, attributes are dropped alphabetically. Protected attributes (K8s identity, workload, device-specific, `cloud.*`, `host.*`, `hw.*`) are never dropped.

## Configuration

| Field | Description | Default |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `max_total_attributes` | Maximum combined count of resource, scope, and datapoint attributes per metric datapoint. | `150` |

### Example

```yaml
processors:
  awsattributelimit:
    max_total_attributes: 150
```
